context: M3 o1. Penn Station cab line, Seventh Ave side. Delroy leans on his cab.

lines.speaker: char.delroy_tate
lines.text: There he is. The man with no license and all the streets in his head.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: License lapsed, Delroy. The streets didn't.

lines.speaker: char.delroy_tate
lines.text: I got a date with a plate of ribs. Three hours. You drive, you split the meter.

lines.speaker: char.delroy_tate
lines.text: Rules. Sixth goes up, Seventh comes down, Broadway does what it wants.

lines.speaker: char.delroy_tate
lines.text: Twenty-Third, Thirty-Fourth, Forty-Second, two-way. Everything else, read the arrows.

lines.speaker: char.delroy_tate
lines.text: Wrong way, the fare yells and the tip dies. Right way, you're a genius.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Go eat, Delroy. I'll bring her back without a scratch.
